Return 1 oclock image texture is nearly coincident, under 1 pixel relative to both earlier 1 oclock checks in this observed run.
Forgetting New Record did not invalidate these separate original images and matching sidecars. A three-frame portable derived record was created.
UI roles were inherited (Reference1 on all three) and do not encode independent 5/7 roles. This check group must not be fed to automatic localization.
Do not adjust CAD dimensions to compensate these physical reference holes. Their manufacturing error, optical imaging and localization error are not separated.
